newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yasuda Fire to take majority stake in CIGNA unit.
newsitem.headline: Yasuda Fire to take majority stake in CIGNA unit.

text.p: Japan's Yasuda Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd said on Monday that it would boost its business cooperation with CIGNA Corp of the United States by taking a majority stake in CIGNA's Japanese unit, INA Life Insurance Co.

Yasuda said in a statement that it had acquired 10 percent of INA in July 1993 and planned to boost this to more than 50 percent sometime in near future after obtaining approval from the Japanese authorities.
Koichi Ariyoshi, president of Yasuda Fire & Marine, told reporters that it might take one or two years to complete the procedure of buying the majority stake in INA.
He did not disclose the cost of the purchase of INA shares.

"It is the first time for a Japanese non-life insurance company takes over a life insurance company," he said. "We have had cooperation over the past 15 years and this experience made it possible," he added.
He also said that the relationship between Cigna and Yasuda Fire is an example of private sector cooperation for the Japanese and U.S. industries.
